description: Capability for the only window: core defaults, native open-file dialog, revealing a generated output file in Finder (no generic shell access), and every ST-IA application command. The window is granted NO shell permission at all: the sidecars are spawned from Rust, and a Rust-side call does not traverse the capability system — which gates only IPC calls coming from the WebView. See ADR-003 and finding M10-F11.
